# lmw jobs tracked

Show the jobs in your job tracker: saved, applied...

```
lmw jobs tracked [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  lmw jobs tracked
  lmw jobs tracked --stage applied
```

### Options

```
  -h, --help           help for tracked
  -n, --limit int      number of jobs (1-50) (default 10)
      --stage string   stage: saved, in-progress, applied, interview, archived (default "saved")
```

### Options inherited from parent commands

```
      --json      print JSON output
  -v, --verbose   show debug logs, including every API request
```
